changelog: **The zoom really works now.** 1.0.88.0 tidied the zoom into one source and split the toggles, which was worth doing, but it did not fix the bug: the slider still did nothing. The cause was one word. The store held the current channel in a plain field rather than a reactive one, so everything keyed off the channel - the zoom, both toggles, and the grid's own height - was worked out once while there was no channel yet and never worked out again. The slider wrote a real number under a real channel and the grid went on reading a key that had been empty when it last looked. Switching to Week and back "helped" because the view *was* reactive, and was the only thing that could make the grid look again.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
